scope.source: existing private remote summary/action CSVs only

definitions.eef_path_xyz_native_units: sum of Euclidean distances between consecutive captured end-effector xyz states (state_7..state_9); the audit does not assert a physical unit
definitions.gripper_state_range: per-rollout max minus min of captured gripper state (state_13)

interpretation.supported: In this small paired set, failures all reached the 300-step cap and had a longer mean end-effector path than successes.
not_supported: The logs do not establish whether a failure occurred during approach, grasp, transport, release, placement, or terminal verification.
Similar aggregate gripper-state ranges do not establish successful contact or grasp.
These descriptive differences do not show that path length caused failure or distinguish policy limitation from environment variability.
missing_observables: object pose relative to gripper and target
interpretation.sampling_limit: The 20 paired initializations each have one final-checkpoint rollout; fixed-init3 repeats are reported separately and are not independent seeds.

options_compared.option: treat longer path as proof of a grasp/placement failure
options_compared.reason: The captured state/action schema has no object pose, contact, or grasp observables.

options_compared.option: repeat the same training or rerun the same evaluation immediately
options_compared.reason: It adds compute without adding the missing failure-stage observables and risks duplicating completed evidence.

options_compared.option: freeze a separate instrumented, evaluation-only diagnostic protocol with object/contact/stage logging
options_compared.reason: It can distinguish approach/grasp/transport/placement/termination hypotheses without changing training or overwriting this evaluation. It requires a new unique output root, a predeclared stage rubric and explicit authorization before any GPU rollouts.

options_compared.option: scale task count or unlock Fold02
options_compared.reason: The predeclared single-task fixed-init3 gate failed (3/5), and this audit does not change that result.

next_action: Do not launch another GPU workload automatically. If authorized, first register and review an instrumented evaluation-only protocol, then run only the bounded diagnostic; keep task-count scaling and Fold02 locked.
